elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner

"for a period of 90 days following performance of the Services"
"repair, replacement, or a refund of the fees paid"
"a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverables, Interface or software"
"it will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement"
"free from viruses, worms, Trojan horses and any other malicious code"
12-month software period exceeds the 90-day fallback floor
90-day services period exceeds the 30-day fallback floor
"at TrueLink's option, repair, replacement, or a refund of the fees paid"

reasons: All ten atomic preferred elements are expressly supplied by the inserted Section 9a: professional and workmanlike Services, services/deliverables conformance for 90 days from performance, software conformance to documentation for 12 months from delivery, compliance with laws, no malicious code, and repair/replacement/refund remedies.

The insertion is a concise addition to a clause that previously contained only a Y2K warranty; no existing sentence, the evidence/repair mechanic, or the disclaimer paragraph was altered, so nothing beyond what the preferred level requires was changed.

Minor, non-flaggable notes: the remedy election sits "at TrueLink's option" and the refund is limited to "fees paid"; the drafting also relies on "Services" and "Support Services", which should track the defined terms used elsewhere in the Agreement to avoid a dangling reference.
Fallback periods and remedies are also satisfied on their own terms, so the clause is compliant at either level.
